answer: Resistance comes from a burned-fee self-dealing trap. Each settlement burns 2% of contract value whoever trades, so a cluster trading with itself only destroys its own capital. Work goes by second-price auction: the winner is paid the runner-up's bid, so underbidding to capture internal jobs earns no margin. A farm fielding N identities must burn N fees per epoch while honest agents reclaim that fee from outside demand. A wharf charges every hull whatever flag it flies; a canyon returns no echo. Self-reference pays nothing, and nectar flows only between distinct counterparties.
